ammonia.reason: Amino-acid deamination during 2-4 mo ripening raises pH to 6.6 with headspace ammonia noted.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole and branched acids from proteolysis and needled-paste microflora.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic bitter peptides from chymosin plus P. roqueforti aspartyl proteases.

blue_moldy.reason: P. roqueforti beta-oxidation of fatty acids to 2-heptanone/2-nonanone methyl ketones.

browning.reason: Maillard on residual lactose and glutamate when heated, limited by high moisture.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate fermentation to diacetyl/acetoin in high-fat curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: P. roqueforti lipolysis liberating 6924 mg/kg butanoic plus 3171 mg/kg hexanoic acid.

creaminess.reason: 34.1% fat, 56.7% FDM with mold proteolysis softening paste to creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Dry-salted unpressed needled curd with open blue veins fracturing easily.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard 39.8% moisture uncooked pressed curd, firm but yielding.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol, masked by blue notes.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butyrate/hexanoate esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol by mold esterases.

goaty.reason: 3171 mg/kg hexanoic/caproic acid from mold lipolysis of cow milk fat.

malty_nutty.reason: Leu/Ile/Val Strecker aldehydes and low 111 mg/kg propionic acid from starter metabolism.

melt.reason: Moderate fat and pH 6.6 demineralized casein flows but salt and veins limit full flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Linoleic acid oxidation to 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one by P. roqueforti lipoxygenase.

oil_off.reason: Free fat release from 56.7% FDM lipolyzed matrix on heating.

sour_vinegar.reason: 1742 mg/kg acetic acid plus 2.15% lactic acidity from starter and lactate oxidation.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata stretching; rennet curd lacks aligned paracasein network.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methionine catabolism to dimethyl sulfide/disulfide; uncooked curd so low cooked note.

sweet.reason: Low residual lactose; slight sweetness from glycerol and free amino acids at high pH.

umami.reason: Extensive proteolysis SN 46.8% liberating glutamate/aspartate peptides and free amino acids.
